context:
Goal: a session that resumes after a compaction learns that its hooks lag main.
Problem (rule): the session start hook does not run after a compaction, so a compacted session never learns its hooks are older than main, and changing when it runs is a settings.json edit that needs your word.
Based on (read): settings.json on main today runs the start hook only on a new or resumed session, not after a compaction.
Based on (read): PR #2473 adds a line to the start hook that says when a session's hooks are older than main.
Departs from: main settings.json SessionStart matcher `startup|resume` — becomes `startup|resume|compact`, so session_start.sh also runs after a compaction.
Meanwhile: nothing waits on this; a fresh session is the route for a stale lane.

options.gain: A compacted session sees that its hooks lag main.
options.how: A lane adds `compact` to the matcher and proves your pick with page_grant.py.
options.label: Yes, add compact to the matcher (Recommended)
options.lose: One extra hook run per compaction: 2 git reads and 1 bounded fetch.

options.label: No, keep the matcher
options.lose: Stale hooks stay unseen after a compaction.

ref: settings.json SessionStart matcher; PR #2473 (the hooks-lag line)
reply: Picked a at 19:22 CST. Done 00:52 CST Nov 10: PR #2481 added compact to the matcher and merged in batch 70 (0e6509a96). Step compact-resume-runs-start is done (roadmap ebc9b0a56).
title: Run the session start hook after a compaction too, so a compacted session learns its hooks lag main?
